name: [RESOLVED] System Integration - API Performance Optimized
description: Customer reported intermittent timeout issues when calling the REST API endpoints. Error occurred approximately 30% of the time during peak hours. Root cause identified and resolved.
resolution: Issue was caused by inefficient database queries during peak load. Implemented query optimization, added connection pooling, and configured caching layer. Performance tests show 95% improvement in response times. No timeout errors observed after deployment.
